name: Thien Cung Cave
kicker: Show cave on the short boat
summary: Show cave on the short boat: walk the lit chamber on Đầu Gỗ inside a 3–4 hour route. The floor is about 3,000 m² and 20 m above the sea, and the pale stalactites give it the name of a heavenly palace. The same boat continues to Đầu Gỗ and then Ba Hang. Keep the day for the whole loop.
getThere: Route 1 boat from the Ha Long passenger port
heroCaption: The lit chamber, with a column and the ceiling in frame

notice.title: The clock is the whole route
notice.body: Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang together. Sửng Sốt, on the long boat, is also 20 m above the sea.

body: You land on đảo Đầu Gỗ and walk the chamber. The floor is about 3,000 m², 20 m above the sea, and the pale stalactites are why the name means a heavenly palace. The same boat then goes to Đầu Gỗ. Keep time for the rest of the loop.

Ba Hang is the end of the same route: three small notch caves close together, opening onto two salt lakes, by kayak or rowboat. A kayak or a rowboat there is 40,000 đồng a person. Hòn Chó Đá and Hòn Đỉnh Hương are looked at from the deck.

figures.caption: Formations inside the chamber
figures.alt: Limestone formations inside Thien Cung Cave in Ha Long Bay

gettingThere: The boat is route 1 from Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long. The English port line is Beach road, New Beach, Bai Chay ward, 500 m from Sun World. A road minute does not apply. The route is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang together.

legs.heading: From the Ha Long port
legs.body: Route 1. The clock is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang together.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Confirm the sailing the day you go.
admissionNote: No separate cave price. Route 1 on 15 March 2024 is 440,000–460,000 đồng, split there as 310,000 sightseeing and 150,000 boat. Inside the 310,000, 60,000 is the port fee and 250,000 is the remainder in that notice. The board exemption page, updated 2 November 2024: free under 1.2 m or under 7, half price for a Vietnamese citizen 60 or over, and 20 percent off from age 7 to under 16. The 15 March 2024 port sentence uses children 7 to 15 for the 20 percent. From 10 December 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport.
